content:
alex: Ran a perf sweep on mixtral-8k (head_dim=96) across A100 and H100. Observed the FlashAttention path is ~2x slower than SDPA for some seq lengths. Repro steps and numbers below.

alex: repro command:
```bash
./serve_bench --model mixtral-l7 --seq 2048 --batch 1 --head-dim 96 --use-flash true
```

alex: results (A100 driver 520.56.09):
```
SDPA path: 120 ms/token
Flash path: 240 ms/token (unexpected)
Triton fallback: 140 ms/token
kernel log: flash_attn_kernel.cu: launch_status=INVALID_MASK at mask_apply()
```

maya: Can you paste the kernel selection trace from the run? curious where we pick Flash vs SDPA. :eyes:

alex: trace snippet:
```
kernel_selector: model=mixtral-l7 head_dim=96 seq=2048 seq_bucket=2048
choose_kernel: flash_attn_candidate=true
check_flash_compat: head_dim_mod16=0? false (96 % 16 = 0? actually 96 % 16 = 0)
mask_check: seq_len%8 != 0 -> mask_align_fail=true
select_kernel: fallback_to_flash=true (bug?)
```

jin: hmm. head_dim=96 is divisible by 16, but we still hit mask alignment checks. Could be a seq_len vs block size mismatch or a masking bug in our flash wrapper.

oli: we've seen similar with Qwen-14 (head_dim=80) on V100 where masked kernels assumed 8-wide lanes and blow up when seq%8 != 0.

alex: tried toggling RoPE scaling flags. disabling rope_scale makes Flash fast again but changes logits slightly. Perf numbers: Flash w/rope_scale=on -> 240ms, Flash w/rope_scale=off -> 118ms.

perf-bot: [perf-alert] mixtral-8k canary latency +8% since 2026-03-10 (route: hosted-inference/us-west).

maya: proposal: add an explicit kernel-selection heuristic that rejects Flash for masks when seq_len%8 != 0 or when mask_apply returns nonzero. Prefer SDPA or Triton fallback rather than forcing a buggy flash kernel. Also add a fast-path pad: align seq to 8/16 when safe.

jin: I'll implement heuristic: if (head_dim % 16 != 0) || (seq_len % 8 != 0) then prefer SDPA unless model config sets allow_flash_unaligned = true. Also add an env var REDWOOD_FORCE_FLASH for experiments.

alex: another improvement: pad KV cache inner dim to 128 multiple on allocation so loads are aligned. Microbench shows 6-12% improvement and prevents misaligned loads triggering slower paths.

oli: good call. we should be careful with memory overhead for private deployments. add opt-in pad and a config knob.

maya: i'll open an eng-runtime ticket with logs/trace and perf numbers and assign to @jin, include test matrix (Mistral/Mixtral/Qwen, head_dim variants 64/80/96/128, seq 256/512/1024/2048).

jin: will add unit tests and a perf CI run for these variants. plan: patch kernel selector -> land -> canary -> monitor perf-bot.

alex: :thumbsup: dropping full kernel stack trace and nvprof output into the ticket now.

oli: quick note — check Triton kernel versions; older Triton gave different behavior when mask broadcasting was used. Might be a driver/Triton combo problem.

maya: yep. add driver matrix to ticket (520.x, 525.x, 530.x) and H100/A100.

alex: thanks team. let's aim for a changelist by EOW so canary lands early next week.
